components.css: .ds-service{border-top:1px solid var(--line,#d6d0c6);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#d6d0c6);padding-block:23px;color:var(--ink,#252422);font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif}.ds-service summary{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:24px;cursor:pointer;list-style:none}.ds-service summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.ds-service h3{margin:0;font:400 28px/1.1 var(--serif,"Cormorant Garamond",Georgia,serif);letter-spacing:-.02em}.ds-service summary>svg{color:var(--accent,#a75b43);flex-shrink:0;transition:transform .3s}.ds-service[open] summary>svg{transform:rotate(45deg)}.ds-service summary p{font-size:13px;line-height:1.8;color:var(--muted,#6a645d);max-width:380px;margin:13px 0 0}.ds-service-details{font-size:13px;line-height:1.85;color:var(--muted,#6a645d);max-width:380px;padding-top:14px}.ds-service-details a{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;color:var(--accent,#a75b43);margin-top:15px;width:fit-content;text-decoration:none}.ds-service-details a svg{width:15px;height:15px}.ds-service summary:focus-visible,.ds-service-details a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#a75b43);outline-offset:6px}@media(max-width:700px){.ds-service{padding-block:21px}.ds-service h3{font-size:27px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-service summary>svg{transition:none}}

narrative.overview:
The user-pinned architectural magazine world pairs warm paper and graphite with restrained terracotta. Cyrillic Cormorant Garamond provides the expressive voice; Manrope keeps navigation, descriptions and forms quiet and practical. Large interior photographs, open margins and fine rules carry the composition.

Photography supplies the material richness: timber, daylight, stone and spatial depth. The interface stays flat and precise around it. This record describes the implemented responsive landing page; the name, portfolio and AI assets remain visibly illustrative, with no awards or testimonials presented as proof.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper, graphite and a single terracotta accent.
Cyrillic serif headlines with italic emphasis; restrained sans-serif utility text.
Large rectangular photography and deliberately unequal image sizes.
Fine dividers, square fields and circular controls only where the interaction calls for them.
Gentle motion with visible content by default and a reduced-motion alternative.

rules.name: The Accent as Emphasis Rule
rules.body: Use terracotta for italic emphasis, directional cues, interactive feedback and focus. Keep the broad reading surfaces warm and neutral.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Use Cormorant Garamond for expressive headings and editorial statements; use Manrope for navigation, explanatory copy, metadata and form controls.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Let photography and tonal section changes create depth. Keep content cards unboxed; reserve the existing shadow for the mobile navigation overlay and the comparison ring for keyboard focus.

dos: Do preserve the paper, graphite and terracotta roles established in the frontmatter.
Do keep serif italic emphasis selective and pair it with quiet Manrope utility text.
Do use real architectural photography with rectangular crops and deliberate asymmetry.
Do retain visible focus, native keyboard interaction and the reduced-motion alternative.
Do keep demonstration and AI disclosures visible beside the content they qualify.
donts: Don't add awards, testimonials or achievements without real supplied evidence.
Don't replace the photography-led world with ornamental cards, decorative gradients or repeated rounded containers.
Don't turn the circular comparison and scroll controls into a general corner treatment.
Don't hide essential content behind an animation or require hover to open a project.
Don't show a successful enquiry state while the endpoint is unset.
